name: workflow-js
description: Guidance for using the Upstash Workflow SDK to define, trigger, and manage durable serverless workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Build durable serverless workflows with the Upstash Workflow SDK
interface.longDescription:
Upstash Workflow lets you write durable, multi-step serverless functions with delivery guarantees, automatic retries, sleeps, and event waits — without managing infrastructure.

This plugin teaches coding agents how to use the @upstash/workflow SDK: define workflow endpoints with serve, run steps through context (run, sleep, call, waitForEvent, notify, invoke), and manage runs with the Workflow client (trigger, cancel, notify, inspect). Use it when creating workflow endpoints, orchestrating multi-step jobs, adding reliability or flow control, or integrating wait/notify and webhook patterns.

Guidance comes from the skill already in this repository at skills/SKILL.md and its linked docs — one source of truth, not a copy.
defaultPrompt: Create a durable Upstash Workflow endpoint with multiple context.run steps
Trigger a workflow run and wait for an external event before continuing
Add retries, flow control, and a failure callback to my workflow
